messages:
maria g: Hey team — I'm abroad and my physical insurance card was stolen last night. I have an urgent dental extraction at 11am local. Can someone confirm what I can show the clinic for proof of coverage?

jamal: Oh no, sorry to hear that. First step — log into the benefits portal and download the ID card PDF. URL: https://benefits.redwood.com -> My Benefits -> ID Card. If you can't access it, we can generate a temporary letter.

lisa p: @maria g if you DM me your employee ID I can pull a verification letter and email it to the clinic. They usually accept a benefits confirmation letter + a photo ID.

maria g: Clinic says they need something official immediately. I can't log in because MFA is asking for my phone which is gone.

people-ops-bot: Automated notice: If MFA issues prevent portal access, escalate with People Ops via urgent-benefits@redwood.ai — response SLA: 2 business hours.

alex: @maria g — I'll get you a same-day verification PDF. Please confirm your full name and DOB here or DM if you'd rather. Also tell me the clinic email to send to.

maria g: Sent you a DM with details. Clinic email is records@sevencitiesdental.example. Thanks so much.

jamal: While you wait, screenshot this snippet to show coverage level (not official but helps):

```
Plan: Redwood Core PPO
Member: Maria Gonzalez (EmpID 9234)
Effective: 2025-09-01
Coverage: Preventive 100%, Basic 80% after deductible
```

lisa p: Clinic acceptance tips: ask them to accept emailed verification, ask for pre-authorization if they need procedure approval. If they demand a card, our verification letter should suffice.

alex: Done — I emailed the verification letter to records@sevencitiesdental.example and cc'd maria.g@redwood.ai. Attached is a PDF with the group number and policy confirmation. Let me know if clinic needs us to fax it. :white_check_mark:

maria g: Received it and forwarded to the clinic. They accepted the email and scheduled me for 11:20. You all are lifesavers. :pray:

people-ops-bot: Case note: temporary verification provided by People Ops (alex). Logged under ticket #PO-7821. If claims follow-up needed after treatment, open a benefits ticket with claim details and provider CPT codes.

jamal: Quick FYI for clarity — once you're back we can issue a replacement physical card and add a phone number for MFA backup. Recommend enabling an authenticator app for travel.

maria g: Will do. Thank you everyone! :thumbsup:
